services.desc: What to bring: Sunscreen, (non-aerosol), Cooler for fillets w ice, Beverages, if adult beverages please limit the number as intoxication is not allowed and the boat will immediately return to the dock if warranted. Non-markable closed-toe footwear, food, and water, Sunglasses, Clothing appropriate for the weather (usually cooler on the water). Is there any medical concerns regarding any of the passengers i.e.; allergies (food, bees, nuts, etc), medical issues (previous heart attacks, stroke, or physical restrictions), epi-pen use, or asthma conditions the Captain should be aware of ? Fish Limits per person: Scup, 30 or 40 Fish per person limit of 11″, Sea Bass 4 Fish per person limit of

blurb: Fish Bandit offers fishing charters led by Captain Skip Bandini and sells fishing apparel designed for comfort, moisture wicking, UV protection, and high visibility on the water. The apparel features neon colors for safety and is suitable for various weather conditions. The business emphasizes safety and performance in both their charters and apparel.
